texts.orig: ATTACHMENT TO GRANT Myriota Pty Ltd ICFS File No. SES-STA-20260621-01857
texts.text: ATTACHMENT TO GRANT Myriota Pty Ltd ICFS File No. SES-STA-20260621-01857

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Operations under this grant must comport with the legal and technical specifications set forth by the applicant or petitioner and with Federal Communication Commission's rules not waived herein. This grant is also subject to the following conditions:
texts.text: Operations under this grant must comport with the legal and technical specifications set forth by the applicant or petitioner and with Federal Communication Commission's rules not waived herein. This grant is also subject to the following conditions:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. STA operations must not exceed the operational power levels and parameters requested and coordinated, and must comport with the technical specifications described in the underlying application, as amended, except as conditioned in this grant of STA.
texts.text: STA operations must not exceed the operational power levels and parameters requested and coordinated, and must comport with the technical specifications described in the underlying application, as amended, except as conditioned in this grant of STA.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. STA operations must use the minimum power level necessary to establish communications links in order to minimize potential interference to licensed users.
texts.text: STA operations must use the minimum power level necessary to establish communications links in order to minimize potential interference to licensed users.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. All operations under this grant of STA must be on an unprotected and non-interference basis (NIB), i.e., Myriota must not cause harmful interference to and must not claim protection from interference caused to it by any other lawfully operating station.
texts.text: All operations under this grant of STA must be on an unprotected and non-interference basis (NIB), i.e., Myriota must not cause harmful interference to and must not claim protection from interference caused to it by any other lawfully operating station.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4. In the event of any harmful interference caused by operations under this grant of STA, Myriota must immediately cease operations upon notification of such interference. Myriota must immediately inform the Commission, in writing, of such an event.
texts.text: In the event of any harmful interference caused by operations under this grant of STA, Myriota must immediately cease operations upon notification of such interference. Myriota must immediately inform the Commission, in writing, of such an event.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5. Myriota to coordinate with NASA in accordance with Footnote 5.376A, via  fas@scan.nasa.gov prior to operations that use frequencies overlapping 1660-1660.5 MHz and occur within a 75 km radius of 35° 14' 17' N, 116° 46' 44' W.
texts.text: Myriota to coordinate with NASA in accordance with Footnote 5.376A, via  fas@scan.nasa.gov prior to operations that use frequencies overlapping 1660-1660.5 MHz and occur within a 75 km radius of 35° 14' 17' N, 116° 46' 44' W.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6. The 24/7 point of contact in the United States, with authority and ability to cease all emissions, for this operation is George Kanuck at +1 (512) 686-8233.
texts.text: The 24/7 point of contact in the United States, with authority and ability to cease all emissions, for this operation is George Kanuck at +1 (512) 686-8233.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7. STA operations must be in compliance with earth station applicable operations allowed by the space station authorization(s) or grant(s), including all relevant conditions, waivers, and findings therein.
texts.text: STA operations must be in compliance with earth station applicable operations allowed by the space station authorization(s) or grant(s), including all relevant conditions, waivers, and findings therein.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8. STA operations since the expiration of the previous STA and the commencement of this STA were authorized as continuing operations under 47 CFR § 1.62.
texts.text: STA operations since the expiration of the previous STA and the commencement of this STA were authorized as continuing operations under 47 CFR § 1.62.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This grant is issued pursuant to section 0.261 of the Commission's rules on delegated authority, 47 CFR § 0.261, and is effective upon release. This STA is authorized pursuant to the Commission's rule 47 CFR § 25.120.
texts.text: This grant is issued pursuant to section 0.261 of the Commission's rules on delegated authority, 47 CFR § 0.261, and is effective upon release. This STA is authorized pursuant to the Commission's rule 47 CFR § 25.120.
